# Generated Output

Running `python3 tools/build.py` writes one bootable ADF and one payload per
case here, together with `suite-v1.json`.

Generated files are ignored. The source, builder, and recorded toolchain can
reproduce them. This README and `.gitignore` are the only tracked files in
this directory.

## Related files

- [`../tools/README.md`](../tools/README.md) defines the build process.
- [`../schema/suite-v1.schema.json`](../schema/suite-v1.schema.json) defines
  the generated manifest.
